sensitivity: Internal reference. Present results to users only in neutral wording (e.g. 'marital harmony', 'compatibility'), never explicit language.

definitions.reference: Houses counted from LAGNA unless stated.
definitions.harmony_houses: House 12 (ayana-sayana-bhoga sthana) and lord_12 decide marital intimacy/harmony.
definitions.spouse_view: For the spouse's experience, take the 12th from the 7th (= 6th from Lagna) and the 12th from Venus.

rules.condition: lord_12 strong (own sign / exalted / well placed)
rules.result: Marital harmony and intimacy are fully enjoyed; no deficiency indicated.

rules.name: Dasa check via 12th from dasa lord
rules.condition: Take the sign of the current dasa lord; find the 12th sign from it; if that 12th sign's lord aspects that 12th sign
rules.result: No marital-harmony problems during that dasa.
rules.example: Rahu dasa with Rahu in Simmam: 12th from Simmam is Kadagam; Moon aspecting Kadagam from Magaram -> no issue in Rahu dasa.

rules.name: Spouse's experience
rules.condition: lord of 12th-from-7th conjoined with the 4th-from-Venus lord (comfort lord) and well placed
Saturn (esp. debilitated) in 12th from 7th (i.e. 6th from Lagna)
rules.result: Occasional mood mismatches / timing differences between partners; no physical inability or refusal indicated - a matter of adjustment.

rules.name: Venus in 7th own sign
rules.result: Malavya yoga (Pancha Mahapurusha) - karako bhava nashti does NOT apply; no marital concern from this placement.

rules.name: Lagna lord / 6th lord in 8th
rules.condition: lagna lord or lord_6 in 8th AND dispositor strong (e.g. in trikona with Jupiter aspect)

progeny_rules.name: Jupiter in 5th
progeny_rules.condition: Jupiter in 5th in own sign (or exalted)
progeny_rules.result: Karako bhava nashti cancelled - children assured.
progeny_rules.contrast: Concern applies only if Jupiter in 5th is debilitated/weak.

progeny_rules.condition: PG-01 holds BUT Jupiter sits in the nakshatra of a debilitated planet
progeny_rules.result: Children still come; only some delay.

guidance: Always combine natal promise with the running dasa/bhukti before concluding.
A bhukti lord in 8th (e.g. Sun as 10th lord in 8th) can create worry/doubt without actual deficiency - avoid alarming the querent.
open_questions_for_implementation: Aspect set to use for MH-02 (full Vedic aspects?)
